title: All Are Yours, And You Belong
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 86
summary: This shabad opens with all are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all. It turns the heart toward at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels inflated, defensive, and self-protective because the shabad keeps ego inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਸੁ ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhas dhaa too(n) sabhanaa raas ||
lines.translation: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tudhai paasahu ma(n)gadhe nit kar aradhaas ||
lines.translation: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis too(n) dheh tis sabh kichh milai ikanaa dhoor hai paas ||
lines.translation: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh baajhahu thaau ko naahee jis paasahu ma(n)geeaai man vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
lines.translation: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tudhai no saalaahadhe dhar gurmukhaa no paragaas ||9||
lines.translation: All praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened. ||9||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: all are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.
The middle movement widens the correction through those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened.
